reviews.text: I don't think this would work for my face because of the citrus. But I used it on my arms and neck and did see an improvement and skin tone eveness and dark spots.
reviews.zh: 我覺得呢款唔適合我嘅面，因為含有柑橘類成分。不過我用喺手臂同頸，確實見到膚色均勻度同色斑有改善。

reviews.text: L'ho comprata per me, ma è stata "sequestrata" da mio padre perchè su di me risultava troppo grassa. Ne è rimasto contentissimo, e ha notato un'effettiva riduzione di macchie scure sulla pelle nonostante non sia certo un utilizzatore assiduo. Ne ha già voluto un'altra confezione.
reviews.zh: 我係買畀自己用嘅，但係畀我爸「沒收」咗，因為我覺得佢對我嚟講太油膩。佢好滿意，雖然佢唔係經常用，都見到皮膚上嘅色斑有實際減少。佢已經想再要多一盒。

reviews.text: Bought it for my dad, he only likes this product now. I do see any effects on dark spots. It’s just a good moisturiser if you want something lightweight.
reviews.zh: 我買畀我爸，佢而家就只鍾意呢款產品。我對色斑睇唔到有任何效果。如果你想要一款輕盈嘅保濕產品，佢係一款好好嘅產品。

reviews.text: La textura de esta crema es ligera y nada pesada, se absorve muy rápido y no deja grasa la piel. Tiene un olor muy agradable a citricos sin ser tan exagerado. He notado mi rostro más iluminado y con mayor vitalidad, lo complemento con el serum de la misma marca para mejores resultados.
reviews.zh: 呢款面霜質地好輕，一啲都唔重，吸收得好快，唔會令皮膚油膩。佢有好舒服嘅柑橘香味，但唔會太濃。我留意到我嘅面更亮、更有活力，我會配同一品牌嘅精華一齊用，效果會更好。

reviews.text: This cream is a citrusy burst of radiance! Lightweight yet deeply hydrating, it sinks into the skin instantly, leaving it fresh, smooth, and glowing ! Not greasy at all.Unlike other vitamin C creams that feel sticky or heavy, this one is a dream under makeup 🩷everything applies flawlessly on top.A real glow-booster with zero fuss.Highly recommended for dull skin days or when your face just needs a little ✨ pick-me-up ✨
reviews.zh: 呢款面霜係柑橘味嘅亮澤爆發！質地輕盈但保濕力好深，即刻滲入皮膚，令皮膚清新、順滑、有光澤。一啲都唔油膩。唔似其他黏黏或者厚重嘅維他命 C 面霜，呢款放喺化妝底下用超級好 🩷，上面再疊嘢都好完美。係一款好簡單就有光澤感嘅產品。好推薦畀皮膚暗淡嘅日子，或者當你個面需要少少提神嘅時候 ✨

reviews.text:
J’ai reçu cette crème, je n’ai pas testé à cause de la mauvaise composition (silicone…). 
En plus elle est jaune, j’ai peur qu’elle laisse un teint jaune mauvaise mine, je pense m’en débarrasser
reviews.zh: 我收到呢款面霜，但係因為成分唔好（有矽靈……），所以冇試過。而且佢係黃色，我怕佢會令我面色變成黃黃哋、好似唔精神，我諗緊會將佢扔咗。

reviews.text: This cream is light the skin absorbs it quickly, when applied at night I notice my face is brighter next morning. I highly recommend this face cream from Skinfood for me its the best cream this year.
reviews.zh: 呢款面霜好輕，皮膚吸收得好快。我晚上搽咗，第二朝發覺面亮咗。我非常推薦呢款 Skinfood 面霜，對我嚟講係今年最好嘅面霜。

reviews.text: i have serums of this , I buy this cream after because last time it’s not have in stock, this set who who want bright skin and have dark sport .
reviews.zh: 我已經有呢個系列嘅精華。我之後先買咗呢款面霜，因為上次冇貨。呢套適合想皮膚亮啲、有色斑嘅人。
